runtime: Actual V2.10 modules with substituted DOM/browser shell

results.test: Legacy canonical history retains unknown person, time, definition and document provenance
Two named people have separate form bindings and assignment-specific canonical answers
Duplicate named assignment reuses that person’s draft and never captures another respondent’s answers
Owner or active independent risk assignment is required; self-review and expired grants are rejected
A submission dialog names the actual actor and cannot substitute a freely selected submitter
Another acting person cannot submit an internal respondent’s draft
Every new unmapped form creates a source-owned response review and actionable reviewer notification
Assigned program owner can review another person’s response; an unassigned reviewer cannot decide
Revoked reviewer authority blocks acceptance and reassignment preserves the original route history
Changed submitted answer snapshots and actual canonical identity invalidate review
Return and resubmission retain exact previous answers, checksum, comments and named actors
Canonical correction opens an independent next run and retains immutable previous source history
Requirement conclusions require accepted current facts and preserve accepted posture during later drafts
External supplier person, internal recorder and independent reviewer remain separately attributed
Program-basis drift invalidates readiness without rewriting historical acceptance or conclusions
Unavailable pinned documents block acceptance but allow an attributable correction request
Program changes during actual document verification cannot race a satisfied requirement decision
Scope and actor changes invalidate open assignment/submission dialogs without mutations
Designer previews are explicitly non-assessment drafts and cannot create unassigned submitted reviews
Program and form pages expose named respondent, actual history and reviewer without hidden navigation
History export includes exact people, reviewer comments, cycles and checksum within current scope
New pages render registered actions and exact source destinations without numeric placeholders
